# Calccover

> Free commercial insurance calculators for small business owners, contractors, and fleet operators. Estimate workers' comp, general liability, commercial auto, and other business insurance costs across all 50 US states.

## Research & Data

- [Commercial Insurance Costs by State (2026 Analysis)](https://calccover.com/commercial-insurance-costs-by-state/): State-by-state analysis of workers' comp, general liability, and commercial auto costs across all 50 US states. Includes downloadable 50-state dataset.

## Free Calculators

- [Commercial Truck Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/commercial-truck-insurance-calculator/): Estimate annual premiums for owner-operators and small fleets.
- [General Liability Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/general-liability-insurance-calculator/): Estimate general liability premiums by industry, revenue, and employees.
- [Workers Comp Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/workers-comp-insurance-calculator/): Estimate workers compensation costs by state, payroll, and class code.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/commercial-auto-insurance-calculator/): Estimate commercial auto insurance by vehicle type and fleet size.
- [Restaurant Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/restaurant-insurance-calculator/): Estimate insurance costs for restaurants and food service.
- [Contractor Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/contractor-insurance-calculator/): Estimate liability and workers comp for construction contractors.
- [Cyber Liability Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/cyber-liability-insurance-calculator/): Estimate cyber liability premiums by revenue and data exposure.
- [Professional Liability Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/professional-liability-insurance-calculator/): Estimate E&O insurance for consultants and professional services.
- [Business Owners Policy Calculator](https://calccover.com/business-owners-policy-calculator/): Estimate bundled BOP premiums for small businesses.
- [Commercial Property Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/commercial-property-insurance-calculator/): Estimate building and contents coverage costs.
- [Errors and Omissions Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/errors-omissions-insurance-calculator/): Estimate E&O premiums for professional firms.
- [Liquor Liability Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/liquor-liability-insurance-calculator/): Estimate liquor liability for bars, restaurants, and venues.
- [Business Interruption Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/business-interruption-insurance-calculator/): Calculate recommended BI coverage limits.
- [Commercial Umbrella Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/commercial-umbrella-insurance-calculator/): Estimate excess liability coverage costs.
- [Cargo Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/cargo-insurance-calculator/): Estimate cargo insurance for freight shipments.
- [Semi Truck Insurance Cost Calculator](https://calccover.com/semi-truck-insurance-cost-calculator/): Estimate semi truck insurance by state and driving record.
- [Owner-Operator Insurance Calculator](https://calccover.com/owner-operator-insurance-calculator/): Insurance costs for single-truck owner-operators.

- All calculators are free and require no signup
- Data is sourced from NAIC, ISO, state insurance departments, and industry publications
- Press inquiries: hello@calccover.com
